messages:
Ava M.: Quick sync — Cloud Connector co-marketing. Need a tight plan for: launch post + benchmark narrative, joint webinar, and inbound lead routing. Target publish week of 4/10. Who owns which pieces?

Tom P.: I can own partner comms + webinar ops. Webinar week of 4/8 works. Need a joint demo (15m) + 20m talk + 10m Q&A. Also want 2 slide benchmark: latency and cost comparison.

Ravi S.: I’ll draft the launch blog and the benchmark narrative. Can we get the test numbers from eng-ml? @ginger or @max in eng-ml for 99th p90 and tokens/sec stats? :pray:

Jules R.: I’ll own inbound routing. Proposed basic routing logic below — happy to tweak: 
```
rules:
  - source: partner_form
    partner: cloud-connector
    route_to: sales.team=connectors
    priority: high
    notify: slack:#sales-connector-leads
  - source: webinar_reg
    partner: cloud-connector
    route_to: marketing-ops
    tag: webinar_reg
    webhook: https://hooks.internal/mql
```
Add opt-in flag for partner follow-up.

MarketplaceBot: New partner listing draft uploaded: https://portal.internal/partners/cloud-connector/draft (permissions: marketing, partnerships)

Tom P.: Tracking notes — use UTM params: utm_source=cloud-connector&utm_medium=co-marketing&utm_campaign=connector_launch. Add hidden form field partner=cloud-connector. Webhook should map partner -> account.owner if exists.

Ava M.: Action items and deadlines:
- Ravi: blog + benchmark draft by 2026-03-28
- Tom: webinar runbook + slide deck by 2026-03-30
- Jules: routing spec + form config + webhook test by 2026-03-29
Meeting: 2026-03-24 10:00 PT (30m) to align on messaging and demo. :calendar:

Jules R.: Routing snippet for the form (will hand to eng-ops):
```json
{"form_id":"connector_signup","fields":{"email":"required","company":"required","partner":"cloud-connector","utm_campaign":"connector_launch"},"post_submit":{"webhook":"https://hooks.internal/mql","mapping":{"partner":"metadata.partner","email":"lead.email","company":"lead.company"}}}
```
Will include rate-limit and spam-honeypot.

Ravi S.: For the benchmark, prefer these test vectors: 2 prompts at 4k tokens context, batch sizes 1 and 8, measure p50/p95/p99 latency, and cost per 1k tokens. I’ll pull evals and make a clean table. Need eng-ml numbers by 3/25.

Tom P.: Call to action for webinar: registrants -> partner demo page -> 'Request Dedicated' CTA (flows to sales queue). Use partner-specific landing so analytics attribute correctly. I’ll sync with Sales Ops on SLA for demo handoff.

Ava M.: Messaging elevator: "Predictable inference with deployment flexibility — reduce unit cost without sacrificing latency." Keep two headline options for blog. Ravi, draft both short and long headlines.

Ravi S.: Will do. Also will include a small benchmark callout image for social.

Tom P.: I’ll own the webinar promo calendar (email, partner co-email, social). Plan: 3 nurture emails, 2 partner-shared posts, LinkedIn ads targeted to platform engineers and ML leads.

Jules R.: Confirmed I’ll run a webhook test by 3/29 and post results in #marketing (ops). Will add a Replay link for QA.

Ava M.: Perfect. I’ll create Asana tasks and tag everyone. Quick note on approvals: legal review for partner logos on blog (Tom), security sign-off for webhook (Jules).

Tom P.: +1. Also request a short partner quote for the blog — Tom (partner contact) can provide by 3/26.

Ravi S.: Great — I’ll mock a quote stub we can send to partner.

Jules R.: :thumbsup:

Ava M.: Thanks team — see you on 3/24. I’ll drop the calendar invite and attach the draft runbook.
